$comment: What every scheduled route owes, measured by scripts/check-cron-contract.mjs against apps/web/app/api/cron and vercel.json. vercel.json is changed only through a reviewed deploy change, so a collision recorded here is one the guard refuses to let grow.

boundedByConstruction.reason: it walks FINANCIAL_RETENTION_RULES, a constant in the repository, and each rule is one bounded statement
it walks the alerts one evaluation produced, which is at most one per rollout under evaluation
it walks PROVIDER_COST_REPORT_CLIENTS, a constant list of provider adapters

allowedCollisions.reason: both are scheduled at 40 4 every day and both sweep organization-scoped rows; the schedules live in vercel.json, which only a reviewed deploy change may edit
allowedCollisions.fix: in vercel.json move /api/cron/enforce-domain-retention from "40 4 * * *" to "50 4 * * *", the next free slot in the nightly retention block
